text_block_list.text: One day, at the training course—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-B-B-Big news, Bono-o-o-o-o!!
Carrotman is... Carrotman is!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Coming to the academy's event race-e-e-e-e-e!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh~.
So Carrotman is the guest this time~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If you win, you get to share the stage
with Carrotman at the live performance!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa!!
I'm definitely gonna win and show him what I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Biko-chan♪
I'll bake a cake to cheer you on~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! Before that, Bono,
I need you to help me with my training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Got it! So I just put on this mask
and pretend to be Carrotman, right~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Practicing for when I meet the real deal
is super important, right? Counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman?
text_block_list.text:
All righty...! Monsters, everyone,
let's eat some cake and make up, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a sec~! That's just regular Bono!
Carrotman is way more like—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohohoho!
Seems you girls are in a bind!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Th-That voice is...!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If it's the role of Carrotman,
I, Seeking the Pearl, wouldn't mind taking it on...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah, really~?
We're in good hands with Pearl-san♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me♪ I shall show you
a world-class Carrotman...!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
Full nutrition! Full justice!
Carotene Charge, Carrotman!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-It's Carrotma-a-a-an!!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Biko Pegasus-kun!
Thank you for always cheering me on so passionately!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huhh?! Ah, no, cheering for a hero
is just common sense, or rather...-!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to sharing the stage with you soon!!
Now, show me your running right away!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to...?! Carrotman seeing my
running... by running...?! Awawawa...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Gwaaah!! Why can't I speak properly?!
Even though Carrotman is talking to me!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Why... I can't find my stride...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Made it in time~.
Everyone, over here, over here~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... We cheer for Biko-san
from right here, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eye copy☆
Maya wants Biko-chan to win, too!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ready, set... Do your be-e-e-est!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(...I can hear everyone's voices.
Their voices cheering for me...!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Get a grip, Biko Pegasus!
Is this pathetic sight what you wanted to show them?!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(No, it's not!!
If it were Carrotman... If it were a true hero!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A hero gives courage through their running-g-g-g-g!!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, splendid!! Through your running,
your justice has reached right into my heart!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All ri-i-i-ight!! Just watch me!
I'm definitely gonna win the upcoming race!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Nfufu, good luck!
I'll be cheering for you, Pegasus Girl♪
